outcome: A split card with fuse may be cast as both halves only from hand; cast from another zone, only one half is castable.
note: Choosing both halves is a decision; castability from hand only is the verdict.

outcome: A fused split spell on the stack has the combined characteristics (colors, mana value, types) of both halves.
The cost to cast a fused split spell is the sum of both halves' mana costs.
A fused split spell resolves by performing the left half's instructions and then the right half's.
